Hero_Desc_Shady:
Phantoms all want to be her.
No other phantom can pull off a prank on the scale of Shaydi's pranks.
She mentioned something about ending the world being the ultimate prank.
Album_Like_Shady: Great jokes that shake up the world. The mess she makes.
Album_Wish_Shady: Pulling off the best prank of all time.
Album_Shady1: A self-proclaimed, 'greatest prankster,' Shaydi is a phantom who lives up such pronouncements, with abilities befitting such a title and acts as if she's from another planet. They say phantoms in phantom society constantly strive to be like Shaydi.
Album_Shady2: Shaydi is reluctant to mention her age, presumably because the other phantoms suggest she's the oldest among them. She seems to dislike being treated like Rim, who is allegedly around the same age...
Album_Shady3: Shaydi's pranking method isn't about being smart but rather about pinpointing factors the opponent can't ignore. Her secret approach is the 'checkmate prank' where once you're the target, you're forced to suck it up even when you know it's just a prank.
Album_Shady4: It appears Shaydi's weakness may be her unusual sense of kinship with Rim. Or rather than weakness, could it be akin to 'sisterhood?' The exact expression doesn't come to mind. What's clear is that, somewhere in her heart, there's some guilt for leaving Rim by herself.
Album_Shady5: Shaydi has been spotted hiding near Rim's house, watching her from a distance. When I pressed her about her odd obsession with Rim, Shaydi confessed they were, in fact, more like sisters, created around the same time...
Album_Shady6: I asked Shaydi if she also cherished her scythe like Rim does. Denying any similarity to her, Shaydi threw her scythe on the ground. Seconds later, she hurriedly picked it up, as she broke into a cold sweat.
Album_Shady7: Shaydi confessed that she feels an odd sense of envy toward Rim. Apparently, Rim used to be "super fun," which made Shaydi envious. So over time, Shaydi subtly influenced Rim into being "no fun," eventually altering her entire personality. Now, Shaydi seems to carry some guilt for what she did.

LoveCall_Shady:
Hello~ This is your delivery driver. Your order has arrived. The tracking number is 6894-1732-5081, correct? The building entrance is blocked, so I cannot come inside. I will just throw it somewhere in the parking lot and leave, okay? Understood? Find it yourself.

Ahaha~ It is a joke, a joke. Honestly, you knew from the moment you answered, right? It is not as though this is the first time I have fooled you. If you genuinely fell for it, that means you are slow. It is not my fault.

Honestly, I expected you not to answer because you would assume it was a prank call. But you picked up without a second thought. You should not answer every random call, understood? My calls, of course, you must answer immediately.

Am I bored? Yes, rather. The Ghost Swamp has been quiet lately, so I decided to call. You happened to be bored too, did you not? Then we both enjoyed ourselves, which is good for both of us.

I know you are busy, but visit the Ghost Swamp once in a while. Our ghost village may look gloomy, but it guarantees entertainment, right? Once you arrive, you will have fun.

Go back to whatever you were doing. I would feel bad if I bothered you too much.

I will call again later, understood? You must answer then too, okay?

Right, good work~!
